decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal, because it involves the reduction in size of a retail unit in a primary shopping parade, would create a Class A1 unit of a substandard size, with insufficient storage space and would contribute to a decline in the attractiveness and function of this local shopping parade, and would be contrary to Policy S.1.1 (main shopping areas) and S.2.1 (non retail uses in primary frontages) of this Council's Unitary Development Plan and Policies S.1.1 and S.1.2 of the Council's Revised Deposit UDP.

Condition : 3 - (Car parking)
The proposal, because of the lack of on site storage or adequate serving arrangements to the rear of the  Class A1 unit, and because of inadequate car parking provision, would lead to an unsatisfactory development of the site, with insufficient car parking arrangements, and so would be likely to give rise to additional indiscriminate kerbside car parking at and within the vicinity of the site, which in turn would be detrimental to the safety of both vehicles and pedestrians, and would also be contrary to Policy T2.5 of this Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use of part of retail unit (No 210) to restaurant use to extend existing restaurant at (No 211)
